title: Finite-energy lattice percolation with internal critical probability one
strongest_verified_claim: For every fixed d>=2, the constructed fully automorphism-invariant, translation-mixing bond law has ordinary finite energy and almost surely a unique infinite component, with quenched internal bond and site thresholds one for both X and that component. The general one-ended-tree perturbation and both planar HM deductions are also supported.
